subject: PO tagging and itemization discrepancies — Stratify Tech onboarding

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor setup request: Stratify Tech onboarding (PO needed)

Hi Monica / Laura,

We're ready to onboard Stratify Tech as a payments/partner vendor. They returned the onboarding packet and W-9 (attached) and have asked us to issue an initial PO so they can begin provisioning. Key notes:
- Vendor name: Stratify Tech (EIN on W-9 attached)
- Initial purchase: integration services + one-time config ($15,000) and recurring monthly license ($2,500/mo)
- They requested a single PO that includes both the one-time and the first three months of license lines (they say procurement teams in their ERP require a consolidated PO).

Attachments: Stratify_Onboarding_Form.pdf, W9_StratifiyTech.pdf

Can procurement generate a PO and advise on spend cap rules for recurring line items? If a single PO is not advisable we can split into PO + renewal contract. Also: they want the PO tagged to our partner code PART-STRAT.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@stratify-tech.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor setup request: Stratify Tech onboarding (PO needed)

Hi Sergio,

Thanks — confirmed we attached the onboarding form and W-9. For clarity, the consolidated PO will let our finance team auto-apply the setup fee and pre-fund the first quarter of licenses. If Redwood prefers separate POs that’s fine, but we need the invoice codes as follows:
- LINE 1001 — Integration & configuration — $15,000 (one-time)
- LINE 2001 — Monthly license — $2,500 per month (quantity: 3 months = $7,500)

We can accept a spend cap at the PO level if you need it. Please include PART-STRAT in the PO reference to route invoices correctly.

Regards,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Finance Operations
Stratify Tech

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-08T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup request: Stratify Tech onboarding (PO needed)

Sergio / Monica,

Thanks for the docs. I started a Procurement ticket (PO-98765) and prelim PO draft is ready, but I ran into two issues that need alignment before issuing:
1) Spend cap semantics for recurring licenses — our preferred approach is to issue a PO for the one-time & an initial prepay for 3 months, then set the recurring license to be invoiced monthly against a Purchase Order number with a rolling spend cap (so accounting can track commitments vs actuals). If Stratify insists on a single consolidated PO we can do it but need explicit acknowledgement for forecasting.
2) Line item coding — the vendor's spreadsheet uses LINE IDs 1001/2001, but our chart-of-accounts expects GL codes. I mapped them in the draft but the vendor's invoice sample didn't include our partner tag. Please confirm PART-STRAT reference so I can add it to the PO.

Draft PO details (pending your + vendor confirmation):
- PO #: DRAFT-PO-2026-98765
- Lines:
  * GL 5400 — Vendor professional services — $15,000 (one-time)
  * GL 4100 — SaaS subscriptions — $7,500 (3 months prepay)
- Suggested spend cap field: $22,500 (total committed) with recurring cap note for monthly invoices.

Attachments: draft_po_98765.pdf (internal), mapped_lineitems_v1.xlsx

Could Sergio confirm PART-STRAT tag and ask vendor to confirm final invoice line IDs? Also vendor needs to re-upload the onboarding form with EIN visible for AP.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: PO Team <po@stratify-tech.com>

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the draft and the mapping. Two quick clarifications from our side:
- We can include PART-STRAT in the invoice footer and PO reference. Confirmed.
- We accidentally uploaded a partially redacted W-9 earlier; attached is the unredacted W-9 and a corrected lineitems spreadsheet with accounting-friendly labels (lineitems_v1_corrected.xlsx).

On the consolidated vs split PO question — our ERP prefers a consolidated PO. If Redwood can include the recurring cap note for month-to-month consumption, we will accept the single PO with the three-month prepay lines included.

Updated attachments: W9_StratifiyTech.pdf, lineitems_v1_corrected.xlsx

Regards,
PO Team
Stratify Tech

Team / Elena,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I updated the draft with the corrected W-9 and the vendor's corrected lineitems. Final PO has been issued: PO-98765. Summary below:
- PO#: PO-98765
- Total committed: $22,500 (one-time $15,000 + 3-month license prepay $7,500)
- Spend cap field: $22,500; note added: "Monthly invoices after initial prepay will reference PO-98765 and be subject to the recurring spend cap; additional spend requires PO amendment or new PO."
- GL coding applied: 5400 (services), 4100 (subscriptions)
- Partner tag: PART-STRAT added to PO reference and invoice routing instructions.

Attachments: PO-98765.pdf (official PO) — I've uploaded the PO and the corrected line items to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3-Onboarding-Stratify

Next steps for vendor:
- Confirm receipt and that your billing system will use PO-98765 for the initial invoice and subsequent monthly invoices.
- If you need the PO split, open a PO amendment ticket referencing PO-98765.

Elena / Aaron — please reply to confirm and we'll close the procurement ticket.

—Laura
